scope: Oscillation, beta-endpoint, neutrinoless-double-beta and cosmological neutrino-mass carriers; no GU spectrum, mixing matrix, reality map or Majorana mechanism is constructed.

primary_sources.observable_carrier: joint T2K and NOvA long-baseline appearance and disappearance event spectra
primary_sources.inference_map: flux, interaction and detector likelihoods -> mass-squared splitting, mixing and CP-phase posteriors within three-flavor oscillations
primary_sources.licensed_claim: The joint analysis sharpens Delta m^2_32 and delta_CP constraints and finds no strong mass-ordering preference.
primary_sources.ceiling: Oscillations constrain splittings and mixing; they do not determine the absolute mass scale or whether neutrinos are Dirac or Majorana.

primary_sources.observable_carrier: tritium beta-decay endpoint electron spectrum over 259 measurement days
primary_sources.inference_map: endpoint spectral likelihood -> effective electron-antineutrino mass squared and upper limit
primary_sources.licensed_claim: KATRIN reports a best-fit mass squared consistent with zero and m_beta below 0.45 eV at 90 percent confidence.
primary_sources.ceiling: The endpoint carrier constrains m_beta; it does not resolve ordering, mixing phases or Majorana reality.

primary_sources.observable_carrier: the complete KamLAND-Zen 800 xenon-136 neutrinoless-double-beta exposure
primary_sources.inference_map: event and background likelihood -> half-life lower limit -> effective Majorana-mass interval under light-Majorana exchange and nuclear-matrix-element inputs
primary_sources.licensed_claim: No neutrinoless-double-beta signal is reported; the half-life limit maps to a matrix-element-dependent effective Majorana-mass range.
primary_sources.ceiling: A null result does not establish Dirac neutrinos, and the mass interval is conditional on mechanism and nuclear matrix elements.

primary_sources.observable_carrier: DESI DR2 BAO ratios with named CMB likelihoods
primary_sources.inference_map: cosmological likelihood -> sum-of-neutrino-masses posterior under the selected background and dark-energy model
primary_sources.licensed_claim: DESI plus CMB gives a 95 percent upper limit of 0.064 eV in Lambda-CDM and 0.16 eV in w0-wa CDM.
primary_sources.ceiling: The factor-of-2.5 model shift is direct evidence that the cosmological mass-sum limit is not a model-independent laboratory measurement.

rejected_inferences: oscillation splittings -> the absolute neutrino masses are measured
a neutrinoless-double-beta null -> neutrinos are Dirac
a cosmological mass-sum limit -> a model-independent neutrino spectrum
a forced neutral representation state -> an observed neutrino mass, mixing and Majorana map
precise_relocation: Keep four evidence maps separate. GU owes one source-native neutral operator and observation map producing absolute masses, splittings, mixing, charge/reality semantics and any Majorana channel, then separate evaluations of oscillation, beta-endpoint, neutrinoless-double-beta and cosmological carriers.

ledger_comparison.parent_revival_trigger: a neutrino-sector mass spectrum and mixing map
ledger_comparison.linked_revival_trigger: a stationary odd-form VEV in the located 126 channel

joint_evaluation_constraint: RA-B6 and RA-G3 cannot be credited independently: a forced neutral state and a located odd-form singlet channel become physical neutrino evidence only through one common operator, reality/charge map, mass spectrum and mixing evaluation.
corrected_evaluation_packet: construct one source-native neutral mass operator on a declared domain
derive absolute masses, splittings, mixing and charge/reality semantics
state whether a Majorana channel exists and which lepton-number-violating operator mediates it
evaluate each experimental carrier through its own likelihood and assumptions
